# Hive Commons Docs

## Supported agents and inference engines

Canonical integrations page: https://docs.hivecommons.dev/docs/hive/integrations

Hive supports Claude Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, Goose, OpenAI Codex CLI, Pi, IBM Bob, Aider, Gemini CLI, Google Antigravity CLI, OpenHands, OpenCode, Kilo Code, Muse Code, Oh My Pi, vLLM, llm-d, LiteLLM, IBM watsonx.ai, OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI and DeepSeek.

Spektacular (Spek) is Hive Commons' spec-driven workflow tool; the specs it produces are called speks.

## Infrastructure thanks

Hive Commons thanks Akamai (Linode), Oracle Cloud (OKE), Cloudflare, GitHub Copilot and Bluehost.

## Docs

- [Hive](https://docs.hivecommons.dev/docs/hive/overview/introduction): autonomous AI agent fleets for your repositories
- [hotshot](https://docs.hivecommons.dev/docs/hotshot/overview/introduction): screenshots straight into your AI coding terminal
- [pluk](https://docs.hivecommons.dev/docs/pluk/overview/introduction): pub-sub event streaming for AI agent tmux sessions
- [rationguard](https://docs.hivecommons.dev/docs/rationguard/overview/introduction): detect and rebut rationalization patterns in AI agent output
- [promptargs](https://docs.hivecommons.dev/docs/promptargs/overview/introduction): template expansion for AI prompts
- [dibs](https://docs.hivecommons.dev/docs/dibs/overview/introduction): claim ideas so contributors get credit when agents implement them
- [Spektacular (Spek)](https://docs.hivecommons.dev/docs/spektacular/overview/introduction): spec-driven development for AI coding agents

## Community

- [What is Hive Commons](https://docs.hivecommons.dev/docs/community/what-is-hive-commons)
- [Join Hive Commons](https://docs.hivecommons.dev/docs/community/join-hive-commons)
- [Community meetings](https://docs.hivecommons.dev/docs/community/meetings): every other Thursday, 10:00 AM Eastern time
- [Mailing list](https://hivecommons.dev/join): hivecommons-dev@googlegroups.com; joining adds the community meeting to your calendar
- [Discord](https://hivecommons.dev/discord): community chat
- [Meeting recordings](https://hivecommons.dev/tv): past community meetings on YouTube
